description:
Ability Index: 7. The spell is known as **Fireball** in English, **Feuerball** in German, **Boule de feu** in French, **Bola de fuego** in Spanish, and **Palla di fuoco** in Italian.  

Its effect is described as follows: in English – “Hurls a blazing sphere of fire that explodes on impact.” In German – “Wirft eine brennende Feuersphäre, die beim Aufprall explodiert.” In French – “Lance une sphère de feu flamboyante qui explose à l'impact.” In Spanish – “Lanza una esfera de fuego que explota al impactar.”
